app.name: Pitchforge ERP
app.tagline: One system for sales, projects and the books.

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked after too many attempts. Ask an administrator to unlock it.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
errors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_CODE: That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: This period is locked. Ask a Partner to reopen it.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.STALE_VERSION: Someone else changed this record. Reload it and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This record does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This record has moved on. Reload it to see its current state.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.NOT_BALANCED: Debits and credits do not match. The ledger accepts only balanced entries.
errors.CONTROL_ACCOUNT: This account is posted only by the system. Choose another account.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The two accounts use different currencies.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_WITHDRAWABLE_BALANCE: This is more than the partner may withdraw now. Check the withdrawable balance.
errors.EQUITY_NOT_100_PERCENT: The equity shares must add up to 100%.
errors.WEIGHTS_NOT_100_PERCENT: Milestone weights must add up to 100%.
errors.DUPLICATE_RECORD: A record like this already exists.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrol.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enrol.description: Your role needs a second step at sign-in. Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
enrol.recoveryDescription: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your email and we will send a link that works for 30 minutes.
reset.sentDescription: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has ended
sessionExpired.description: For your security, you are signed out after 60 minutes without activity.

shell.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

home.partnerDescription: Financial year 2026–27 to date. Every figure comes from the ledger.
home.financeDescription: Cash, payables and receivables that need you.
home.employeeDescription: Your tasks, time, leave and payslips. Company finance is hidden for your role.

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this
states.forbiddenDescription: Ask an administrator if you need it.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action needs your password again. You will not be asked for the next five minutes.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.description: For your security, you will be signed out in five minutes unless you continue.

appError.title: This page could not be shown
appError.description: Something went wrong while loading it. Your work elsewhere is not affected.

search.label: Search records
search.title: Search
search.description: Search covers every record you are allowed to see.
search.emptyDescription: Try a document number, a client or a person’s name.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your sign-in details and the devices that are signed in.
account.name: Name
account.sessionsDescription: Sign out any device you do not recognise.
account.passwordDescription: At least 12 characters. Every other device is signed out afterwards.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: One approval engine for bills, claims, journals, drawings, payment runs, purchases, quotations, timesheets and leave. Nobody approves their own request.
approvals.emptyMine: You have not submitted anything that needs approval.
approvals.postingNote: Calculated by the posting engine. Approval and posting are saved in one transaction.
approvals.attachments: {count, plural, =0 {No attachments} one {# attachment, virus-scanned} other {# attachments, virus-scanned}}
approvals.ownRequest: You requested this, so you cannot approve it.
approvals.ownRequestDetail: Segregation of duties: another approver must decide.
approvals.reasonHint: Tell the requester what to change. They will see this.
approvals.reasonInvalid: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The requester is told why.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change to every business record, with who, when and from where. Nobody can edit or delete it.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Users, roles, approval rules and company settings. Changes here are audited.
admin.name: Name
admin.subject: Reminder

finance.title: Payables and bank
finance.billsHint: Bills post to payables when a Partner approves them.
finance.newBillDescription: Saved as a draft. VAT, totals and the posting come from the server.
finance.grossByServer: The gross amount and the journal are worked out by the server when you save.
finance.postingNote: From the posting engine. Nothing posts until a Partner approves.
finance.runsHint: One run pays many bills from one account. Someone other than its preparer approves it.
finance.newRunDescription: Choose bills that are ready to pay. Withholding is worked out by the server.
finance.runSod: The person who prepares a payment run cannot approve it.
finance.nothingToPay: No bills are ready to pay.
finance.adviceReady: The bank advice file is ready.
finance.withholdingByServer: TDS and VDS come from the withholding rules on the server.
finance.ageingDescription: What we owe, by how late it is.
finance.noStatementLines: No statement imported for this account.
finance.postLine: Post an entry for this line
finance.postLineDescription: For charges, interest and settlements the ledger does not have yet.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.immutable: Posted entries cannot be edited or deleted.
ledger.reverseHint: A new entry with the opposite lines is posted today. The original stays as it is.
ledger.manualHint: Every manual journal needs a Partner’s approval before it posts.
ledger.newJvDescription: Saved as a draft. The server checks that it balances when you submit.
ledger.jvNote: Submitting checks the balance, the period and the accounts on the server.
ledger.balanceByServer: Totals are checked by the server; the entry is refused if debits and credits differ.
ledger.chartHint: Accounts marked “posted by the system” take entries only from the posting engine.
ledger.name: Name
ledger.reopened: Period reopened. Every Partner is told.
ledger.reopenDescription: Only a Partner can reopen a locked period, and it is audited. You will confirm your password.

billing.title: Invoices and receivables
billing.invoicesHint: Draft invoices come from signed-off milestones, billing plans and timesheets.
billing.totalsByServer: VAT and totals come from the server’s tax rules.
billing.receiptsHint: A receipt can settle several invoices and record AIT, VDS and retention.
billing.newReceiptDescription: Saved as a draft. Posting it settles the invoice.
billing.deductionsNote: Amounts deducted at source become receivables, so the certificates can be collected.
billing.creditNotesHint: Credit notes and write-offs need a Partner’s approval.
billing.ageingDescription: What clients owe, by how late it is. Open a client for their statement.

tax.vatReturnDescription: Figures for the monthly return, from the ledger.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Capital, current account and anything a partner owes the company, each kept as its own ledger account.
partners.transactionsHint: Drawings above ৳1,50,000 need every other partner. Submitting asks for your password.
partners.drawingSubmitted: Sent to the other partners for approval.
partners.distributionsHint: Shares are weighted by equity over the period, using the history below.
partners.previewDescription: Worked out by the server from the ledger and the equity history.
partners.sharesByServer: Nothing here is calculated in the browser.
partners.equityHint: Effective-dated: a change never rewrites earlier allocations.

projects.title: Projects
projects.noProjects: You are not on any project yet.
projects.timesheetDue: Your timesheet for this week is not submitted yet.
projects.timesheetsHint: Approved hours lock and drive project labour cost.
projects.sheetNote: The total comes from the server.
projects.notFoundDescription: It does not exist, or you are not on it.
projects.moneyHidden: Budgets and profit are hidden for your role.

budgetAlert.warning: More than 75% of the budget is used.

projects.milestonesHint: “Overdue” is a flag next to the real status.
projects.deadlineReasonHint: Every deadline change is recorded with its reason.
projects.signedOff: Sign-off recorded. Finance gets a draft invoice.
projects.taskBoardHint: Change a task’s status from its card.
projects.taskAdded: Task added; the assignee is told.
projects.pnlHint: From the ledger, with approved timesheet hours as labour cost.
projects.noFees: No fee agreements on this project.

crm.title: Sales and tenders
crm.pipelineHint: Each stage carries its own probability; the forecast is weighted by it on the server.
crm.dealWon: Marked won. A project is set up from it.
crm.forecastHint: Expected closes by month, and the same weighted by probability.
crm.quotationsHint: A discount above the limit needs a Partner’s approval. Every revision is kept.
crm.totalsByServer: Discount, VAT and the total come from the server.
crm.quoteRevised: Revision {revision} started; the earlier one is kept.
crm.contractsHint: Retention and warranty dates drive the reminders.

tenders.registerHint: Submission deadlines send reminders at 7, 3 and 1 days.

hr.title: People
hr.description: Self-service, employees, attendance, leave and payroll.
hr.checkInHint: Location is never sent unless you allow it.
hr.myLeaveHint: Balances come from the server: accrued, used and what is left.
hr.noBalances: No leave balances for this account.
hr.newLeaveHint: Saved as a draft; submit it when you are ready.
hr.daysByServer: Working days are counted by the server, leaving out weekends and holidays.
hr.leaveDrafted: Leave request saved as a draft.
hr.payHidden: Pay amounts are hidden for your role.
hr.taxDeclarationHint: Projection for fiscal year 2026–27. Declare investments to lower monthly TDS.
hr.tdsByServer: The rebate and the new monthly TDS are worked out by the server.
hr.name: Name
hr.offboardingStarted: Offboarding started; the clearance checklist is open.
hr.attendanceHint: Late and early-leave are worked out from the shift rules.
hr.shiftsHint: Weekends and lateness rules per shift.
hr.closeMonthHint: Locks attendance for payroll. Needs your password again.
hr.monthClosed: Month closed. Payroll inputs are locked.
hr.whoIsAwayHint: Approved leave only, with no type or reason.
hr.nobodyAway: Nobody is away in this period.

payroll.startRunHint: The server calculates from closed attendance, leave and salary structures.
payroll.calculatingHint: The run appears in the list when it is ready for review.
payroll.bankFileQueued: Bank file is being prepared; the export is logged.
payroll.runLocked: Run locked and posted to the ledger.
payroll.sheetByServer: Overtime, tax and net pay are worked out by the server.
payroll.runsHint: Run totals show no one person’s pay.
payroll.payHidden: Pay amounts are hidden for your role.
payroll.settlementByServer: Encashment, dues and tax are worked out by the server.

procurement.title: Procurement and assets
procurement.description: Requisitions, purchase orders, goods received, the asset register and renewals.
procurement.requisitionsHint: Anyone may ask; a manager or partner approves.
procurement.newRequisitionHint: Saved as a draft; submit it to send it for approval.
procurement.totalByServer: The estimate is added up by the server.
procurement.orderAmended: A new amendment is open as a draft.
procurement.ordersHint: Receive only against an approved order.
procurement.vendorsHint: Bank details are masked and change only after step-up.
procurement.assetsHint: Book values come from the server after each depreciation run.
procurement.runDepreciationHint: Preview a month, then post it to the ledger. Locked months are refused.
procurement.renewalsHint: Reminders go out before each renewal date.

reports.title: Reports
reports.statementsHint: Fiscal year 2026–27 to 31 October. Open an account to see its ledger.
reports.noLines: No lines for this account in the sample.
reports.exportQueued: Export started; it is logged and filtered like the report.
reports.columnsByServer: Columns your role may not read are left out by the server.
reports.schedulesHint: Each recipient receives only what their own permissions allow.
